name: polyql
description: Write SQL with Poly-QL's schema knowledge: table search, join paths, business definitions, knowledge notes, SQL validation and optional read-only execution.

polyql_home.title: Poly-QL checkout
polyql_home.description: Path to your Poly-QL clone (the folder with backend/mcp_server.py). Leave empty when the plugin runs from the clone itself.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Python that has Poly-QL's dependencies and mcp installed. Leave empty to use <checkout>/.venv, then python3.

instance.title: Default instance
instance.description: Database instance the commands use when you do not name one. Leave empty for 'default' (all instances).

enable_generate.title: Enable generate_sql
enable_generate.description: Set to 1 to expose generate_sql, which calls Poly-QL's own LLM pipeline and costs tokens. Leave empty to keep it off.

db_url.title: Database URL for execute_sql
db_url.description: Read-only connection URL (POLYQL_MCP_DB), e.g. postgresql://readonly@host/db. Leave empty to keep execute_sql off.
